Verify the saved video has no audio track

  1. Wait for the download link. The tool reopens the output to verify it contains only a video track.
  2. Play the result at normal player volume, then open the downloaded file. To verify independently, check the file’s track list in an editor or media inspector.
  3. If you also want to keep a separate soundtrack, extract the audio from the source file before sharing the silent copy.

In four test files, each output kept all 96 encoded video packets byte for byte and had zero audio tracks. Download the comparison results.

The tool removes audio throughout the clip. To keep a shorter silent clip, trim it by start and end time.

Which formats can be copied?

A compatible MP4 or MOV exports as MP4. WebM stays WebM. Use a file with one video track and optional audio tracks. The operation stops if it cannot copy the picture into the output container or the source has other track types. If the file already has no audio track, you can use it as it is.

Video data is copied with Mediabunny. The file container can change, so the download may have a different size. The original remains available on your device.
